texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_ESTEPA_ATACANTE_1: Grass to the horizon, low hills and old burial mounds: nowhere to hide on this steppe. Use the gullies and the mounds well.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_ESTEPA_ATACANTE_2: The caravanserai by the river is the key to the road. Take it and hold it.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_ESTEPA_DEFENSOR_1: They come over the open steppe. Our horsemen will find them long before they reach the river.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_ESTEPA_DEFENSOR_2: Hold the caravanserai and its walls. Whoever holds it holds the crossing.
